text:
Evelyn (Product): quick UX check — compliance asked why Region, Key owner, and Retention feel scattered. Should we surface "Region" as a persistent badge or keep everything inside Data protection? mock: https://rwd.example/s/dataprotection-v4 :thinking:
Theo (Design): persistent badge improves discoverability. downside: header real estate. alternative: compact header badge + expanded details in the card.
Jonah (Eng): note: surface level badge means extra metadata fetch on many pages. Can lazy-load but will cause layout shift. We could render a skeleton then hydrate.
Samira (A11y): accessibility concern: when Region is moved to header it must still be semantically tied to Data protection. Use aria-describedby linking the badge to the data-protection heading. Also avoid ambiguous phrases like "Managed" without owner.
Evelyn (Product): suggested compromise: header shows "Region: US-West" small badge (tooltip: "Primary storage region for this account"). Data protection card shows a single-line row: "Encryption: Managed key — AcmeCorp  Manage".
Theo (Design): will mock narrow/wide variants. For tooltips I'll keep them minimal: retention tooltip -> "Default: 30 days (may be overridden by account policy)".
Jonah (Eng): backend detail: retention can be null meaning "use account default". Frontend should show explicit text when null: "Default retention: 30 days" vs "Retention: 7 days (overridden)". Also audit timestamps: support wants local time displayed, CSV should include UTC column.
Samira (A11y): tooltip behavior must be keyboard operable. Make help icon a button with aria-expanded and place aria-live for setting changes: "Encryption updated to Managed key (AcmeCorp)". Export dialog should announce file format and columns before download.
Evelyn (Product): microcopy decisions: region tooltip -> "Primary storage region for this account"; retention tooltip -> "Default: 30 days (may be overridden by account policy)"; export helper copy -> "CSV includes local and UTC timestamps".
Jonah (Eng): implementation tickets: RW-4307 (UI: header region badge + inline key owner), RW-4308 (copy + retention null state + aria), RW-4309 (audit export: add UTC column and update CSV headers).
Theo (Design): I'll update mocks and hand off narrow breakpoint artefacts.
Samira (A11y): I'll add a short checklist to RW-4308 covering focus order, aria-describedby, aria-live text, and keyboard popovers.
Jonah (Eng): tagging release-bot for non-breaking changes. :thumbsup:
release-bot: scheduled release window: 2025-09-02 04:00 UTC for UI copy and export changes.
Evelyn (Product): thanks — I'll add approved strings to the style guide and ping docs for CSV schema note. :memo:
